doc-review.reveal_note: Look at the text on the documents themselves -- AI-generated paperwork often has smudged, repeated, or nonsensical printed text up close.

id-badge.reveal_note: Zoom in on the badge and lanyard -- AI-generated badges often have garbled text/photo details, and lanyard clips or straps that don't attach correctly.

wifi-router.reveal_note: Check the antennas and port/cable connections -- AI-generated electronics often get the number of antennas, port placement, or cable routing subtly wrong.

two-factor-auth.subject_label: Entering a code on a phone
two-factor-auth.reveal_note: Look at the finger position and the phone screen's UI -- AI-generated phone screens often show illegible or inconsistent app interface elements.
